opening.argument: The material presents a front-running bot as a way to obtain extraordinary, supposedly risk-free returns while directing viewers to place their BNB into an externally supplied smart contract. The title promises “10x Daily Without Risks,” and the instructions pair MetaMask setup with copying a contract from an external destination. Viewers are then told, “So we're just going to send some funds. To that contract that we just created,” while the process is described as automatically buying and selling on their behalf. The promised mechanism claims that 90 percent will return to the wallet, with the remainder retained by the protocol, alongside reported results of around 15x and claims of potentially earning upwards of a thousand BNB per day. These are direct prompts to commit funds supported by highly implausible profit claims, not a measured presentation of ordinary trading risk.
